competitorWins: OSINT Industries does a job WorldEye doesn't touch: reverse-searching identities across email, phone, username, name, crypto wallet, IP, domain, and face/image from 1,000+ global sources, then building digital profiles with geospatial mapping and dynamic timelines — including eliminating false positives. For due diligence, vetting, skip-tracing, or identity investigation, it goes orders of magnitude deeper than anything on a globe dashboard. description: OSINT Industries (UK, founded 2023) is a credit-based OSINT data platform for reverse searches on emails, phone numbers, usernames, names, crypto wallets, IPs, domains, and faces/images — drawing from 1,000+ global sources to build detailed digital profiles with geospatial movement mapping and activity timelines. It's an identity-investigation workspace; WorldEye is a live visual-monitoring platform (3D globe, flights, ships, 74,229 cameras, weather) — different jobs entirely, complementary in a security workflow.
